behaviors_asserted: c.header() writes to #preparedHeaders in the context.
The res setter only merges prepared headers into the handler Response when this.#res is truthy (guard: if (this.#res && _res)).
When merging, the setter deletes the handler Response's 'set-cookie' header and then re-appends only the context's cookies, causing the handler's cookies to be lost.
When this.#res is falsy, #preparedHeaders are never merged into the handler Response, so middleware-set cookies are lost.
Expected behavior: both middleware and handler Set-Cookie headers should be present in the final response.
